exposure: Placental stiffness (Shear-Wave Elastography (SWE) and Shear-Wave Velocity (SWV))
cohort: The study included 147 patients with singleton pregnancies and an anterior placental site, divided into preeclampsia, fetal growth restriction, and low-risk pregnancy groups.
finding: The study demonstrated significantly increased placental stiffness (SWE and SWV) in both preeclampsia and fetal growth restriction groups compared to controls, with the difference being more prominent in preeclampsia.
cross-section timing: Between March 2019 and March 2020, during the second and third trimesters of pregnancy.
